no-restricted-syntax.message: vi.waitFor/vi.waitUntil must pass an explicit timeout: the 1s default flakes on the loaded Windows CI runner, where one real git or child-process spawn takes 100-200ms. Use { timeout: 10_000 } when waiting on real git/fs/processes, { timeout: 5_000 } when waiting on in-memory state.
